name: Boca Raton Airport

runway.v: one runway, 5/23, 6,276 ft x 150 ft (about 1,913 m) including displaced thresholds; take-off distance 6,276 ft both ways, landing distance 5,580 ft (rwy 5) and 5,898 ft (rwy 23)
runway.quote: bring the total length to 6,276 feet long by 150 feet wide

hours.v: public airport, open 24 hours; control tower 07:00-23:00 local (Palm Beach approach when closed)
hours.quote: required to be open for operations 24 hours a day

customs.v: CBP user-fee facility, 10:30-18:30 local Thursday to Monday, closed Tuesday and Wednesday; after-hours clearing on request by phone during business hours (USD 360 flat fee plus the regular fee)

noise.v: voluntary noise abatement: no intersection take-offs, minimise reverse thrust, straight-in approaches discouraged; ATC instructions take precedence
noise.quote: MINIMIZE REVERSE THRUST — use FULL runway

handling.v: two FBOs, Atlantic Aviation and Signature Aviation, 24-hour service; no public ramp, so every arrival uses an FBO
handling.quote: Two Full-Service Fixed Based Operators (FBOs) offering 24-hour service

notes: Boca Raton Airport Authority pages read (customs page updated 23 Nov 2026). FAA airport diagram (Jul 2026) shows no runway length; current Chart Supplement could not be opened. No landing fee charged by the Authority. FAA identifier BCT.
